chapter_title: The Chapter of the Three Seasons
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Three Great States of Redemption

---

**¶1:** From the time when divine wisdom proceeded forth and was subjected to profanation within the realm of falsity from evil, to the state when the complete form of the regenerated human will rise and all wisdom that had been entangled with falsity will be wholly separated and restored to purity — from that state onward, from that beginning to the state of final consummation, there are three great spiritual states.

**¶2:** Three states: from the time when the celestial principle of divine love descended into the deepest hells and waged spiritual combat and temptation-struggle against the ruling self-love that governs all the dominions of falsity, together with all its subordinate powers. That celestial love prevailed, while the goods and truths born from it remained behind, still conjoined with those states of evil [GAP-1] in the [GAP-2] until that love shall reclaim all of them [GAP-3] it subjugated all the powers of evil so that not one escaped its dominion. It won a great victory [GAP-4]. The celestial principle of divine love endured through innumerable successive states of spiritual temptation in the realm of falsity from evil, until it prevailed [GAP-5] and it fulfilled the divine purpose that was ordained from the Infinite itself.

**¶3:** Then there was sent forth the divine truth that proceeds from the Divine, together with the divine good that is the origin of life. These liberated the celestial principle of divine love from its combat in the hells and raised it back to the heavenly state. This is the first spiritual epoch: from the descent of celestial love into the deepest falsity to its restoration to the heavenly state.

**¶4:** The second state begins from the time when the celestial principle of divine love was restored. The divine proceeding truth came, together with the divine truth as formative matrix. They established the order of all spiritual states; they arranged [GAP-6] the divine good as origin and the divine truth as matrix established the order of [GAP-7] all spiritual states, up to the moment when they go forth [GAP-8] — this was reckoned as the second spiritual epoch.

**¶5:** [GAP-9] the whole order of spiritual states [GAP-10] the Divine Truth in its universal manifestation displayed [GAP-11] that which is in the [GAP-12] living; it [GAP-13] it separated celestial good and spiritual beauty from all the powers of life and elevated them to interior states, it cast down the refuse of falsity and evil to hell, and it [GAP-14]. Now, from the moment when the Divine Truth manifesting universally revealed its divine likeness, it began to purify all wisdom from falsity. Evil and falsity from self-love surged upward against it in reaction. The divine likeness was veiled and withdrawn. Falsity from evil came forth [GAP-15] from the realm of darkness. It fashioned false perceptions and persuasions, and monstrous falsities without spiritual life were brought forth and fell. Afterward these fashioned the natural will and understanding in merely corporeal form. Until the moment when the Divine Truth itself descended into the natural plane and [GAP-16] as it accomplished there the divine purpose. It implanted the capacity for regeneration in the natural will, and ascended to interior celestial states.

**¶6:** Now, from the time when the Divine Truth in its universal manifestation revealed its divine likeness until the state when the complete form of the regenerated human will rise at the consummation, this shall be reckoned as the third spiritual epoch.

**¶8:** [GAP-17] endures far longer in spiritual duration than the states the celestial principle of divine love underwent in the realm of falsity from evil. It is a vastly greater measure of spiritual states — more than the other two epochs combined.

**¶9:** The first epoch, which the celestial principle of divine love spent in the realm of falsity and evil — by how much does it exceed in spiritual depth and duration the entire time that this ordered spiritual world has existed? While it remains established?

**¶10:** If you should say that [GAP-18] it is small, if you should [GAP-19] to it [GAP-20] and you inquire [GAP-21] you will perceive: twenty times greater! It is greater still by this other measure that you will discover: thirty times! Lesser still is this other measure [GAP-22] the regenerate will receive the {GAP-23} of perceptions and knowledges [GAP-24] the ages and the successive states [GAP-25] from the natural plane to interior states. This is [GAP-26]

**¶11:** This is the third epoch: from the time when the Divine Truth in its universal manifestation revealed its divine likeness until the complete form of the regenerated human will rise from the undifferentiated mass. That epoch, in its spiritual duration, is greater than the intermediate one; but it does not equal the duration of the states endured by the celestial principle of divine love. For the intermediate epoch, in which the divine good as origin and the divine truth as formative matrix constructed the whole order of spiritual states with all its degrees, is shorter than that of the celestial love's combat in the hells.

**¶12:** Immense is the spiritual epoch of the celestial principle of divine love in the hells! It exceeds in depth and duration the epoch in which the Divine Truth manifesting universally displayed its divine likeness — from that revelation through the final judgment and the rising of the complete regenerated human form. From the time too when the Divine Truth displayed its likeness, until the dissolution of the entire spiritual order [GAP-27] when the divine good and the divine truth as formative matrix shaped the whole order of spiritual states.

**¶13:** These are the [GAP-28] three great spiritual epochs through which the entire work of redemption unfolds.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: From the time when the light came forth and was crucified in the darkness, to the season when the Statue will ascend and the entire light, which was conjoined with the darkness, will be purified and cleansed. From that time on, from that time to the season of the end totals three seasons.

Three seasons: from the time when the First Man went down to the abyss, and waged the war and the struggle against the King of the realms of Darkness and his other powers. He was victorious, while his sons remain behind with them in the worlds [of darkness, and they were mixed] in the [darkness] until he shall catch all of them [back and] he bound them all up, so that not one of them escaped his hand. He won a great victory [over all the powers of darkness] The First Man spent human lifetimes and generations in the land of darkness, until he prevailed [over them and] he fulfilled the will of the greatness that was commanded of him.

Then they sent the Living Spirit, the Father of Life. He brought the First Man up from the struggle, he brought him up to the land of light. This is the first period, from the descent of the First Man to his ascent.

The second season is from the time when the First Man ascended. The Living Spirit came, and the Mother of Life. They set in order the things of the universe, they set up [all things] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living set in order [the things of] the universe, up to the moment when they go out [from it] it was reckoned to the second season.

[After] the universe [was established] the Third Ambassador spread [his image] that is in the [ships of the] living; he [called the living and] he separated beauty from all the powers and scooped it up to the heights, he swept the waste to the abyss, and he [separated the light from the darkness] Now, from the moment when the Ambassador revealed his image he purified the light. Sin spurted up towards him. He hid his image. Sin came [forth] from the darkness. It sculpted the trees and the abortions fell down. Afterwards they sculpted Adam and Eve in the flesh. Until the moment when Jesus was sent and he [came to Adam] as he performed there his will. He gave the hope to Adam, and ascended to the heights.
Now, from the time when the Ambassador displayed his image until the season when the Statue will ascend at the end, shall be reckoned to the third season.
[Nothing] lasts long in the time that the First Man spent in the world of Darkness. It is a very great count of time, more than the (other) two seasons!
The first season, which the First Man spent in the world of Darkness, is how much longer than the time that this universe has been? While it is established?

If you should say that [it exceeds the universe ten times] it is small, if you should [... ...] to him [again] and you consult [him] you will tell him: Twenty times! It is greater again in this other one that you will consult: Thirty times! Less also is this other one [... ...] people will receive the [fruit] of the trees [... ...] the years and the generations [from the] earth to the heights. This is [the first season]

This is the third period, from the time when the Ambassador revealed his image until the Statue will ascend from the lump. It again, that time, is greater than the intermediate; but it does not come equal to the time of the First Man. For this intermediate season, in which the Father of Life and the Mother of Life constructed the universe with its orders, is shorter than that of the First Man.

Great is the period of the First Man! It lasts longer than the season in which the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the world and the Statue ascends. From the time too when the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the universe [is greater than the time] when the Father of Life and the Mother of Life shaped the universe.
These are the [great] three periods of time that occur.

fills.fill: of darkness, and they were mixed
fills.explanation: The five sons of the First Man were swallowed by the dark powers and became "mixed" with them — the foundational Manichaean concept of the cosmic mixture, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "still conjoined with those states of evil."
The sons remain "in the darkness" — the primary term throughout this chapter for the realm where the light is trapped, fitting the parallel with "the world of Darkness" used repeatedly in ¶2.
The spiritual reading uses "reclaim" for this catching action; "back" captures the sense of recovering what was lost, and "and" transitions to the next clause about binding the dark powers.

fills.fill: over all the powers of darkness
fills.explanation: The victory is naturally "over" the opponent; "the powers of darkness" echoes the earlier phrase "the King of the realms of Darkness and his other powers" against whom the war was waged.
The natural completion of "prevailed" requires an object ("over them" = the dark powers) and a conjunction ("and") bridging to "he fulfilled the will of the greatness."
The Living Spirit and Mother of Life "set up all things" as a general summary of cosmic construction, paralleling the preceding clause "set in order the things of the universe."
This directly parallels the identical phrase "set in order the things of the universe" used earlier in the same paragraph, creating the characteristic Kephalaia repetitive structure.
After the Living Spirit and Mother of Life complete their ordering, "they go out from it" (depart from the universe), marking the conclusion of the second creative epoch.

Paragraph 5 transitions from the second epoch (cosmic ordering) to the third epoch (Third Ambassador), requiring a temporal connective; "After" naturally introduces what follows the universe's establishment.
The universe having been "established" by the Living Spirit and Mother of Life in the second epoch is the precondition for the Third Ambassador's work in the third epoch.
Confirmed by the same paragraph's later phrase "the Ambassador revealed his image" — the Third Ambassador's cosmic action is to display/spread his divine image through the luminaries.
The "ships of the living" (sun and moon) is the standard Manichaean Kephalaia term for the luminaries through which the Third Ambassador displays his image and purifies light.
The Third Ambassador's first action is to "call" the living light (the Living Soul trapped in matter) upward by displaying his image, before then separating beauty from the dark powers.

fills.fill: separated the light from the darkness
fills.explanation: After scooping beauty upward and sweeping waste downward, the culminating action is the foundational Manichaean summary: separating light from darkness — the very purpose of the Ambassador's cosmic work, corresponding to Swedenborg's separation of good from evil.
"Sin came forth from the darkness" is the natural completion — the standard phrasing for evil emerging from the dark realm in reaction to the Ambassador's withdrawal of his image.
In Manichaean cosmology, Jesus the Luminous was sent to Adam and came to him to awaken him from the sleep of ignorance, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "descended into the natural plane."

The passage establishes that the first season exceeds the other two; "Nothing lasts long compared to the time that the First Man spent in the world of Darkness" expresses this superlative, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "endures far longer than."

fills.fill: it exceeds the universe ten times
fills.explanation: The escalating didactic pattern of 20 times → 30 times strongly implies the initial estimate is 10 times, forming a clean arithmetic progression (+10) characteristic of ancient cosmological teaching dialogues; this directly answers ¶9's question about the ratio.
The passage describes repeated inquiries yielding ever-larger estimates (20 times, 30 times); "again" captures the iterative consultation pattern of returning to inquire further.
The verb "consult" requires a direct object; "him" completes "and you consult him" grammatically, referring to the authority being questioned about the duration of the seasons.

The single most natural word completing "receive the ___ of the trees" is "fruit"; in correspondential terms, fruit = goods of life and understanding received from the trees of knowledge (perceptions and knowledges).

The phrase "from the earth to the heights" is demanded by the spatial structure; "from the" supplies the preposition and article connecting "generations" to the directional phrase "earth to the heights," confirmed by the spiritual reading's "from the natural plane."

Paragraph 10 answers ¶9's question about the first season's immense duration with escalating multiples; "This is the first season" identifies the period just measured, paralleling ¶3's "This is the first period" and ¶11's "This is the third period."

The comparison pattern from ¶11 ("is greater than the intermediate") strongly constrains this medium gap; the third epoch's duration is being compared to the second epoch when the Father and Mother shaped the universe.

The spiritual reading identifies these as "three great spiritual epochs"; "great" is the characteristic Kephalaia adjective for cosmologically significant periods, and the entire chapter emphasizes the immensity of these time spans.
